skills.title: Calendar
skills.description: Checks when you're free and adds events to your phone's calendar.
can: See when you're busy (never titles or attendees)
cannot: Read event titles, attendees or places
Change or delete events it didn't add

skills.title: Scheduled messages
skills.description: Sends a message you wrote, from your phone, at the time you choose.
can: Schedule a message, once or every day
cannot: Send from the server (your phone sends it, encrypted at that moment)

permissions.name: android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
permissions.label: Send at the exact time (Alarms & reminders)
